questions: Do you have a fever or chills?
Are you having any shortness of breath or chest pain when you breathe in (pleuritic pain)?
Do you have any shortness of breath or wheezing when walking around or at rest?
Do you have any sputum when you cough (and if so, what color—clear/white/yellow/green or blood-stained)?
Have you had a measured temperature (e.g., >38°C / 100.4°F) at home or in a clinic?
What is your current oxygen saturation (SpO₂) if you have been measured, or if not, do you notice any worsening when walking that causes you to feel winded?
How long have your cough and pain been going on (days/weeks), and are they getting worse?
Have you noticed any change in the color, amount, or presence of phlegm (sputum) when you cough—e.g., white/clear vs yellow/green vs bloody?
Have you noticed any shortness of breath or fast breathing at rest, or your oxygen saturation being low (e.g., <94%)?
Have you had any chest pain or pain with coughing that feels worse when you take a deep breath (pleuritic pain), or have you been able to feel your lungs “rattling”/heard wheeze?
answers: I don’t know if I had a fever, but I did have chills a little.
No shortness of breath. I don’t have chest pain when I breathe in.
No, I’m not short of breath, and I’m not wheezing right now.
I have a cough, but I don’t know about sputum color. I don’t think I’m coughing up sputum.
No, I don’t think I measured my temperature, so I don’t know if it was over 38°C.
I haven’t had my oxygen saturation checked. And I don’t feel winded when I walk.
It’s been going on for a couple of weeks, since my cold 2 weeks ago. I feel like it’s not getting much worse, but it’s been persistent.
I don’t think there’s much phlegm, and I’m not sure about any color change. I haven’t noticed blood in it.
No—no shortness of breath at rest, and I don’t know my oxygen level, but I haven’t been told it’s low.
I don’t have chest pain with coughing, and it doesn’t feel worse with deep breaths. I haven’t noticed any rattling or wheezing sounds.
